commits.message: send a token that is not valid and check the status code
commits.author: cipoklean

files.patch:
@@ -16,3 +16,10 @@ jobs:
         run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
       - name: test
         run: python -m pytest -q
+      - name: verify token
+        env:
+          LAB_TOKEN=[REDACTED] secrets.LAB_TOKEN }}
+        run: |
+          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $LAB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/user)
+          echo "github api answered $code"
+          test "$code" = "200"
